title: Sci-Fi Luxury Lounge Architect
description: Design a futuristic luxury lounge inside a spaceship hallway by placing velvet sofas around a central pool feature. Users configure the lounge layout, adjust pool water color, position and rotate sofas, set ambient lighting mood, and validate the final architectural composition against spatial constraints.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive sci-fi luxury lounge architect. Load three GLB assets using GLTFLoader: space_ship_hallway.glb as the main environment shell centered at origin, pool.glb placed at the center of the hallway floor as a decorative water feature, and GlamVelvetSofa.glb which the user clones and places around the pool. Camera: use a PerspectiveCamera starting at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin, with OrbitControls for navigation. Lighting: add a warm PointLight above the pool, two cool-toned SpotLights along the hallway walls, and a dim AmbientLight. All lights should have adjustable intensity. Create an HTML control panel (fixed, top-right, styled with dark semi-transparent background and white text) with these interactions: (1) A color picker to change the pool water tint by modifying the emissive color of the pool mesh's material. (2) A 'Place Sofa' button that clones the sofa model and places it at a default position near the pool. (3) Dropdown to select any placed sofa by index. (4) X/Z position sliders (-8 to 8) to move the selected sofa, with validation that sofas cannot overlap (minimum 2 unit distance between centers, show red warning text if violated). (5) A rotation slider (0-360 degrees) for the selected sofa's Y-axis rotation. (6) A lighting mood dropdown (Warm, Cool, Neon) that adjusts all light colors and intensities simultaneously. (7) A 'Validate Layout' button that checks: at least 3 sofas placed, no overlaps, all sofas within 6 units of the pool center, and displays a green success or red error message listing violations. Scale models appropriately so the pool fits inside the hallway. Add a subtle reflection on the pool surface using MeshPhysicalMaterial with roughness 0.1 and metalness 0.3 if accessible. Ensure the hallway encloses the scene convincingly as an architectural shell. Add grid helper on the floor for spatial reference.
